facts.value: Your partner for high-precision manufacturing in demanding oil & gas, offshore, and renewable energy applications — where quality, reliability, and technical performance are critical. HP/HT and exotic material sourcing, supplier qualification, full BOM traceability. 5/6-axis CNC up to Ø2700 mm. Complex geometries, exotic alloys, 20-tonne components. ISO 3834-2 certified. TIG, MIG/MAG, FCAW, SAW, PAW. IWE-supervised. Nickel alloys. RT, UT, PAUT, PT, MT, PMI, CTR, ECT. Level 2–3 certified. Integrated throughout production. Integrated coating facility. Zinc phosphating, epoxy, Xylan, Molykote. FROSIO certified. ISO 9001 quality system. CMM dimensional control. Full MDR, material certs, NCR management. Full system assembly. Hydrostatic, gas, functional testing. Up to 2000 bar test capability. Real-time QR-based traceability. Live KPIs, NCR management, full project transparency. Agile prototype manufacturing for subsea, offshore, and emerging energy technologies. Machining through final test — all in a 6,000 m² facility in Odda in Hardanger. No sub-contracting. No quality gaps between stages. We engage at bid and design phase — DFM review, tolerance challenge, weld geometry assessment —
